Rowan (People Ops): Heads-up: we rolled a modest update to the Performance Review policy — clarified calibration rules, added guidance on goal adjustments mid-cycle, and codified manager training requirement. Managers must acknowledge the policy and finish the 30-min "Calibration Basics" course by Fri 2026-07-15.
Mel (Talent Ops): Tracker is live: https://sheets.redwood/perf-policy-acks. Please set "Reviewed" = Yes + date. Course auto-logs; if it doesn't, paste a screenshot in the sheet.
Victor (Legal): Confirmed wording for US/EMEA. Left one comment for India contractor clause re: local labor law — @Mel can you confirm?
Zoe (Engineering Manager): Quick Q: for managers who join mid-cycle, do they have to do full calibration training or is there a short-track?
Rowan (People Ops): Short-track exists: 15-min "Calibration Quickstart" for interim managers (<90 days). Add note in tracker comments if you used quick-track. Full course required for permanent managers.
Kai (Recruiting): We'll add a gating checklist item to the manager offer pack: "Performance policy ack + training scheduled" so new managers start onboarding compliant.
CalibraBot: Reminder scheduled: Automated DM to managers without ack on Mon 2026-07-12 09:00 UTC.
Mel (Talent Ops): For reporting: admins can export outstanding entries via People Tools. I'll run weekly exports and share CSVs with each People Partner.
Victor (Legal): Also adding a line to the handbook: calibration decisions are advisory and must be documented in the calibration notes. Not retroactive.
Zoe (Engineering Manager): Can we get a 1-pager for team leads to explain goal adjustment process? That would help during team syncs.
Rowan (People Ops): Yep — I'll post a 1-pager + 3-slide TL;DR in #manager-resources by Wed. DM me if you want a team-level compliance CSV.
Mel (Talent Ops): Final ask: Hiring teams, block offers if the hiring manager hasn't acknowledged after 10 business days — @Kai we'll coordinate adding this to the ATS workflow.
Kai (Recruiting): Sounds good, I'll implement the gating rule and notify hiring leads.
Rowan (People Ops): Closing thread: I'll post final compliance numbers after the deadline. Ping here for special cases/leave exemptions.
